title: 25 Years of Mass Surveillance Is Enough
summary: Bruce Schneier, a renowned security expert, argues that 25 years of mass surveillance programs have demonstrated their ineffectiveness and harmful consequences, advocating for a fundamental shift in government surveillance policies and practices.
problem_solved: Addresses the ongoing debate about government mass surveillance programs and their balance with civil liberties.
why_valuable: Provides expert perspective on privacy vs. security trade-offs from a credible cybersecurity voice, contributing to important policy discussions.
